name: KFM Kingdom Holdings Limited
summary: KFM Kingdom Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells precision metal stamping products in the People's Republic of China, South East Asia, Hong Kong, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company manufactures and sells fine metal products; and provides management services.
